Question ID: JOUR_U04_L01_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.MED.01

Source: Headline: New Bike Rack Area Opens Near East Gate. Subheading: The school adds marked parking spaces and a short safety checklist for student cyclists. Body: The school opened a new bike rack area near the east gate on Monday. The article begins with the schedule change, then explains why the location was chosen, then lists safety reminders. A sidebar titled Before You Ride reminds students to lock bikes, walk bikes on sidewalks, and use helmets.
